description: This file defines the SwabbleConfig structure containing nested configuration options for audio, wake settings, hooks, logging, transcripts, and speech. It includes methods for loading and saving configurations, and defines associated errors and logic for file handling.

methods.name: load(at:)
methods.description: Loads the SwabbleConfig from a specified file path, throwing an error if the file does not exist or decoding fails.

methods.name: save(_:at:)
methods.description: Saves the provided SwabbleConfig to a specified file path, creating directories if needed.
